item.title: NCB busts two synthetic drug labs in Greater Noida, seizes drugs worth Rs 50 crore
item.description: The Narcotics Control Bureau conducted a significant raid on two synthetic-drug laboratories in Greater Noida. During the operation, authorities seized large quantities of Methamphetamine and precursor chemicals. Two individuals were arrested, including a Nigerian national using a false identity. Investigators are tracing financial and chemical supply networks linked to the suspects. Citizens are urged to report suspicious activities to promote public safety and environmental health.
item.dc:creator: Raj Shekhar Jha

item.title: Supreme Court’s enquiry committee launches complaint portal over violence during July protests
item.description: A complaint portal has been launched by the High Powered Enquiry Committee for individuals affected by protests. This portal allows victims to confidentially submit their complaints regarding violence that occurred in July. The Ministry of Home Affairs stated that submissions can also be made in person or via post. The committee will prioritize cases involving serious violence, especially against women protesters.
item.dc:creator: Pranjal Pandey

item.title: Man killed, four injured in suspected militant attack on Kuki village in Manipur
item.description: A tragic incident unfolded in Chassad village, Manipur, where a militant attack led to the death of one man and injuries to four others. Gunfire erupted between the militants and a local armed faction, with the violence persisting into the evening. Emergency services promptly transported the injured to a hospital, but sadly, one victim did not survive.
item.dc:creator: Trisha Mahajan

item.title: Woman journalist, who accused Rahul Gandhi of manhandling, files complaint against him, others
item.description: Richa Parasar has alleged mistreatment, threats and use of criminal force against her while she was reporting on a protest near the Supreme Court on October 12, 2026. Parashar, who said she was three months pregnant, has alleged that Rahul Gandhi 'grabbed her hand' and 'pulled her' forward before his security personnel pushed her away while she was covering the INDIA bloc's protest against CEC Gyanesh Kumar on October 12.
item.dc:creator: Rajeev Singh

item.title: 'Nine murders' claim, then a clarification: How 'Chhote Sarkar' has put Nitish, JD(U) on the spot
item.description: Anant Singh is no ordinary legislator as locals rarely use his given name. They call him 'Chhote Sarkar', or little lord, because in the Barh and Mokama belt his word has often counted for more than the government’s. His story begins with his elder brother, Dilip Singh, who won as an independent and became a minister in Lalu Prasad’s cabinet during its first term, from 1990 to 1995.
item.dc:creator: Rajeev Singh

item.title: 'Can't die like this': Indian pilot Smit Machchhar recalls flydubai flight ordeal
item.description: In a shocking incident on September 30, Indian Captain Smit Machchhar endured an assault by his Omani co-pilot aboard flydubai flight FZ1073 en route from Dubai to Tel Aviv. With injury and determination, Machchhar opened the cockpit door, allowing passengers to step in and restrain the assailant. The aircraft landed safely in Tabuk, Saudi Arabia, following a critical altitude drop.
item.dc:creator: Trisha Mahajan

item.title: FSSAI proposes ban on added sugars in infant food for babies up to 6 months
item.description: The Food Safety and Standards Authority of India has proposed a ban on adding fructose and sucrose in infant food. This proposal aims to impose stricter regulations for foods intended for infants up to six months old. The draft amendment seeks to enhance nutritional safeguards during a critical development period. Stakeholders are invited to submit their objections and suggestions regarding the proposal.
item.dc:creator: Pranjal Pandey

item.title: 'An evening in Paris': Opposition questions 'nature' of Punjab CM Mann's France visit
item.description: Punjab Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann's trip to Paris has triggered criticism from opposition leaders and parties. Concerns have been raised regarding drug abuse, law and order, and recent violent incidents in the state. Critics question the appropriateness of Mann's foreign visit, especially as he celebrated his birthday during a crisis. Allegations suggest that he attended a police meeting under the influence of alcohol, which raises further concerns.
item.dc:creator: Trisha Mahajan

item.title: 'How it feels': Dipke shares cheeky SRK post after walking out of jail on conditional bond
item.description: Abhijeet Dipke was granted bail on certain conditions on Saturday, less than 24 hours after Delhi Police took him into preventive custody over his planned 'Tiranga Yatra' in Connaught Place (CP). Dipke was detained shortly after leaving the residence of NCP-SCP spokesperson Anish Gawande, where he had been staying, to attend the planned flag march in Connaught Place.
item.dc:creator: Rajeev Singh

item.title: CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke granted bail within 24 hours of detention; court sets conditions
item.description: Abhijeet Dipke was detained shortly after leaving the residence where he was staying to attend the 'Tiranga Yatra' at Delhi's Connaught Place (CP). As Dipke left the residence of NCP-SCP spokesperson Anish Gawande, a police official told him, "We are placing you under preventive detention. Section 163 is in force in Connaught Place. You are being detained."
item.dc:creator: Rajeev Singh

item.title: 'Another institution being destroyed’: Congress alleges RSS-BJP agenda behind Census 2027 changes
item.description: The Congress party on Saturday expressed alarm over the BJP-led government's decision to broaden the pool of eligible enumerators for Census 2027, prompting the inclusion of teachers from various educational institutions as census officers. Congress general secretary Jairam Ramesh has argued that this change jeopardizes the integrity of the census.
item.dc:creator: Subhadra Srivastava

item.title: Stalin turns fire on Congress over SIR; serves up Bihar, Soren exit reminder
item.description: MK Stalin endorsed protests against the Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls and criticized Congress for its inconsistent positions. During a DMK Parliamentary Party meeting, four resolutions were adopted, including the removal of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. The DMK emphasized its early opposition to the SIR process and questioned Congress's credibility on the issue. Resolutions included support for student protests and criticism of local party leaders’ silence.
item.dc:creator: Pallavi

item.title: CJI Surya Kant urges NLSIU graduates to uphold ethics, defend justice and constitutional values
‘Law and order does not exist’: SAD chief Badal holds CM Mann responsible for Punjab anti-drug activist’s murder
item.description: Sukhbir Singh Badal has held Punjab Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann accountable for the breakdown of law and order following the tragic murder of anti-drug activist Parwinder Singh, also known as Jhota. The incident occurred during an altercation over drug sales at a pharmacy. CM Mann expressed his regret over the incident and assured citizens of a comprehensive investigation.
item.dc:creator: Aryan Singh
